sloka: दुर्गे विनाशिते कर्म भवेत् सुखपरिश्रमम् ।अल्पयत्नेन कार्ये ऽस्मिन् मम स्यात् सफलः श्रमः ।। 5.54.4 ।।।।
transliteration: durge vināśite karma bhavet sukhapariśramam ।alpayatnena kārye 'smin mama syāt saphalaḥ śramaḥ ।। 5.54.4 ।।।।

translations.english: 'If the citadel is destroyed it would be a happy conclusion with a little effort. I can successfully complete my task.
